reason: I only run when my crew drags me out on Saturday, and we already coordinate in our group chat. I'm not going to install a new app on my own, and points I can't cash out plus virtual shoes to repair just sounds like homework.
objection: Half my crew is on iPhone, so the whole 'start together in one room' thing breaks immediately, and the points are pointless if I can't do anything real with them.
would_change_my_mind: If our crew leader set it up and everyone in the Saturday group, including the iPhone people, was actually on it, I'd install it so I'm not left out.
